decisions.mark: concludes that `retryFailedPost` makes exactly one new attempt with no loop or backoff, and on failure marks the post failed again (or removes it for the same three errors)
decisions.detail: QUOTE: Sends `client.createPost` again, with the same redaction-epoch capture as the first attempt. ... On failure, it logs, then either removes the post (for the same three server errors) or sets `failed = true` again. It returns `{error}`. | WHY: The answer describes retryFailedPost sending createPost once more (with retries disabled, no loop) and, on failure, removing the post for the same three errors or marking it failed again. || QUOTE: Sends `client.createPost` again, with the same redaction-epoch capture as the first attempt. ... The "no loop or backoff" part is covered by the single-send description plus the earlier note that the send has retries disabled.
